title: A Wolf for the Salt
author: Silas Hartwell
blurb: Theo Almeida, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
